photos.author: Sapphire Williams
photos.description: A picture of Grand Concourse facing north taken at the bridge of Eugenio María de Hostos Community College of CUNY , between the A and C buildings. The Bronx Central Annex Post Office can be seen on the right side after the B building, as well as the Bronx County Courthouse which can be seen far ahead behind the trees of Franz Sigel Park.
